d: Is bhag men - aachary vishnugupt (chanaky) apne shishyon ko yuddh ke prakaron ke bare men parha rahe hain. vahin kekaiy ke mantri takshashila ke maharaj se milne aate hain. aur batate hain ki kekaiy ki ye mansha kabhi nahin rahi ki kisi bhi sima samjhaute ka ullanghan kare. yadi simaen surakshit rahengi to desh bhi surakshit rahega - aage kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men.
